listingTitle: Pin external GitHub Actions to commit SHAs
title: Pin external GitHub Actions to commit SHAs
why: Tags and branches can move after review, allowing a workflow to execute different third-party code without a repository change.
suggestion: Pin each external action or reusable workflow to a full 40-character commit SHA and retain the release tag in a comment for update tooling.
limitations: One grouped advisory is emitted per checked-in .github/workflows YAML file.
Local actions and docker:// references are excluded; organization-level action policies are not inspected.
